recipe.visualDefinition: A seated male musician with an acoustic guitar positioned against a textured wall featuring a large, airbrushed rainbow arc with vertical paint drips. The scene is grounded by a speckled floor and framed by a dark vertical architectural element on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically but offset horizontally to the left
Rainbow arc framing the subject's head and right side
Vertical paint drips contrasting with the horizontal guitar neck
Warm beige wall tone unifying the vibrant rainbow colors
coreInvariants: Vertical liquid drips intersecting the rainbow bands
Subject seated on a high wooden stool
Checkered shirt and dark vest attire

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Musician is mid-ground, occupying the lower-left quadrant, scaled to approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The acoustic guitar held horizontally across the subject's lap.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the guitar neck right, travels up the rainbow arc, and descends through the paint drips back to the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of textured wall in the upper right and center provides breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant spectral rainbow (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep brown and black of the guitar and vest
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the rainbow graphic against a low-saturation, high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold geometric sans-serif with rounded terminals
letterConstructionRules: Soft, pillowy edges resembling bubble letters
Tight letter spacing with slight overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular 'o' and 'g' with very small apertures

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space of the wall

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavyweight bubble display font paired with delicate, high-contrast serif for tracklists.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the rounded, thick geometric 70s aesthetic
Provides the necessary weight and soft corners

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-shot photo of a man with 70s hair and a checkered shirt sitting on a wooden stool holding an acoustic guitar. Behind him is a beige textured wall with a large airbrushed rainbow arc. Vertical drips of translucent paint run down the wall from the top edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, rounded bubble-style typography in the upper right. The main name should be horizontal, while the secondary title should follow the curve of the rainbow. Add a small serif tracklist on the right side.

verificationChecks: Is the rainbow airbrushed rather than hard-edged?
Are there vertical drips intersecting the rainbow?
Is the typography heavy and rounded?
Is the subject's pose relaxed and centered on the stool?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title

mustAchieve: Balanced use of negative space for text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the guitar neck does not obscure the subject's face
Ensure the rainbow colors are soft and blended
Verify typography is legible against the wall texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Musician] + Background [Airbrushed Rainbow Wall with Drips] + Typography [70s Bubble Display] = Retro Folk Aesthetic
